name: Seahorse Watergun
skillFull: Water Droplets appear at given distances. The Water Droplets slowly rise up, trapping any Jellies they come in contact with. When the Cookie passes through or touches the Water Droplets, they burst and give Water Droplet Points. Level Up for more Water Droplet Points.
